original_card.question: Does a changed construction's serialized target/paid invoice independently support its claimed improvement?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read revision 8, the selected review and live exact-source handoffs. Then follow this card's bounded first_experiment.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only, not a supplier replay or theorem proof.

original_card.first_experiment: Independently recount one changed emitted word and its complete caller, importing no constructor or pricing engine. Include target losses, owned lifetimes, native orientation and extra charges. Check existing #5633/#5708/#5717/#5719 coverage to avoid duplicate audits and preserve its exact head. Stop after the chosen missing implication; a correct root alone is not supplier admission.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.
scope_change_triggers: Changing source head, helper/cut domain, operation alphabet or caller boundary without recording the new scope.
Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

actual_scope: Independent recount, at the exact open PR #7636 head 7e68d8dd62d9a38c0f3c942262a7a85ca7125b75, of (1) the header and initial-chart equality with the #7630 word, (2) the chart chronology of both complete words, (3) the MOVE rank histogram of both words and its relation to the declared 17-call paid invoices, (4) the helper target ranks of both words and their relation to the declared target invoices, and (5) the signs of the declared complete moments at the claim, at the stated crossing, at the upper bracket and at the #7633, #7630 and #7627 values. No constructor, application or pricing engine of the PR is imported.
scope_change_reason: The first experiment of the card is applied to a newer exact head. No audit of #7636 was found among the open PRs on 2026-11-17. #7636 changes 22 composites of the #7630 word and re-derives the hub events jointly. The recount shows that the paid MOVE ranks change and the helper targets and initial charts do not.
bottleneck_link: The complex supplier binds. #7636 changes the paid MOVE rank histogram of the P104 word. Its invoice is the #7630 invoice plus a declared per-call delta. This audit binds that delta to the emitted word bytes.
stop_rule: Stop after the word-to-invoice binding and the moment signs are resolved or one exact mismatch is found. Do not replay the native, signed, physical, ordinary, CLEAR certificate or outer stages.
evidence: verify.py passes on CPython 3.13.9 (Windows) in about 2 s: paid = 17 x (MOVE rank histogram of the word) + one fixed caller histogram, equal for #7630 and #7636 and equal to the one of the #7612, #7630, #7631 and #7633 recounts; targets = 17 x (helper target histogram) + one fixed caller target histogram; the native delta {2:-18,3:-6,4:-20,6:+20,7:+2} is recounted from the words and has total rank zero; the helper delta and the initial-chart delta are empty; both words have a legal chart chronology; ten moment signs agree with the PR, including both sides of the stated crossing at 10^-30; the derivative bounds are negative; and ten controls reject.
